maddeler.e:
اقعنسست (form XIV)
# اِقْعَنْسَسْتُ (iqʕansastu) /iq.ʕan.sas.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِقْعَنْسَسَ (iqʕansasa)
# اِقْعَنْسَسْتَ (iqʕansasta) /iq.ʕan.sas.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِقْعَنْسَسَ (iqʕansasa)
# اِقْعَنْسَسْتِ (iqʕansasti) /iq.ʕan.sas.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِقْعَنْسَسَ (iqʕansasa)
# اِقْعَنْسَسَتْ (iqʕansasat) /iq
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
